summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong Exchange rules, reporting ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. Between March 20 and April 15, 2026, the issuer bought back approximately 11.4 million Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from ~USD 6.57 to USD 7.14 per share, representing a minor fraction of outstanding shares each day. The repurchases are part of an authorized buyback program, with shares not yet cancelled as of the filing date. These open-market purchases reduce the share count over time, boosting per-share metrics. Watch for the pace of buybacks and potential cancellation timing to gauge ongoing capital return commitment.
